description: Plays music by free-text query (searches and starts the best match) or by Spotify URI. Handles "play some Radiohead", "play the album Kind of Blue", "play my Discover Weekly". Reports what it picked — relay that to the user so they can correct it.

device_id.description: Target device id (see the devices tool)

query.description: What to play, e.g. "Bill Evans" or "Kind of Blue". Required unless uri is given.

type.description: What the query refers to (default: track)

uri.description: Spotify URI to play directly, e.g. from a previous search result

name: play
title: Play music
